summary: This is a simple React component that wraps content in a styled span element to highlight it with a background color. It takes two props: the content to highlight (children) and the background color to use, then renders that content with consistent styling like white text and rounded corners.

explanations.11: This imports type definitions from React for JSX (the syntax that looks like HTML in JavaScript) and ReactNode (which means 'anything that React can render').
explanations.13: Props is a TypeScript interface that defines the shape of the object this component receives — it must have children (the content inside the tags) and color (a string for the background color).
explanations.18: The function destructures the Props object to extract children and color as separate variables, and specifies that the component returns a JSX.Element (a React element).
explanations.21: The style object here uses camelCase for CSS properties (like backgroundColor instead of background-color) because this is JavaScript, not plain CSS.
